datalist.name: Sanctum of Conservation
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 5
- Apply the following effect on all allied Identities:
  · On Skill Use, each ally gains Shield equal to (Preservation Potency on Don Quixote x 2)% of their respective max HP (once per turn, max 10%)

- Apply the following effects on all "Le Noir" allied Identities:
  · Offense Level +(Preservation Potency on Don Quixote / 3) (rounded down; max 2)
  · Defense Level +(Preservation Potency on Don Quixote / 2) (rounded down; max 3)

- Apply the following effects on all enemies:
  · Min & Max Speed -1 (this effect cannot reduce Min & Max Speed below 1)
  · Stagger Threshold raised by Tremor Burst +10%
  · Take +10% damage from Skills that consume Charge Count or Unique Charge (from "Le Noir" allied Identities' Skills, take +20% damage instead)

- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
datalist.flavor: A sanctuary in which the value of conservation pursued by Le Noir is preserved. Within it, the Noirs' preservative actions are retained to their benefit. It is a realm of eternal conservation—a place that stirs the drive to infinitely approach death.

datalist.name: Blessing of the Obsidian God
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 100
- Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to (Stack / 5)% of this unit's max HP (rounded down)
- At 25+ Stack, On Base Attack Skill Use, convert all Coins into Unbreakable Coins
- At 40+ Stack, this unit cannot be Staggered (excluding forced Staggers)
datalist.flavor: The Obsidian God. The Obsidian Giant. The Chaplain of the Hammer. The Obsidian God of the Grand Magasin, whose domain is the power of preservation, grants his blessing through direct contact. The hammer is hard, and its black hue absorbs all things and brings them to a halt... much like death itself.

datalist.name: Promised Nail
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 30
- Upon Tremor Burst due to Skill effects, take 1 Sloth damage for every Stack (max 10; once per Skill)
- Turn End: At 4+ Stack, gain 1 Bind next turn
- Turn Start: If Haute Couture::Le Noir Brand Manager Don Quixote is not on the field, expires
datalist.flavor: The promised hammer is bound by promise to drive in a nail. Therefore, whenever the hammer falls, a nail must exist there... even if there is none.
